constraints.name: app_runs_lifecycle
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'queued'::text) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (coverage IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'running'::text) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (coverage IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (coverage IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: app_runs_nvd_counts_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((retrieved_count >= 0) AND (stored_count >= 0) AND (stored_count <= retrieved_count) AND ((page_count >= 0) AND (page_count <= 5)) AND (next_index >= 0) AND ((total_results IS NULL) OR (total_results >= 0))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((selected_cpe IS NOT NULL) AND ("left"(selected_cpe, 8) = 'cpe:2.3:'::text) AND vulntrack.valid_text(selected_cpe, 1024)))

constraints.name: app_runs_nvd_metadata_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(query_parameters) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((query_parameters)::text) <= 4096) AND (jsonb_typeof(warning_codes) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(warning_codes) <= 20) AND (jsonb_typeof(source_timestamps) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(source_timestamps) <= 5) AND (jsonb_typeof(page_manifest) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(page_manifest) <= 5) AND (octet_length((page_manifest)::text) <= 8192)))

constraints.name: app_runs_nvd_outcome_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((request_key IS NULL) OR (((status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text])) AND (coverage IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (page_count > 0) AND (coverage IS NOT NULL) AND ((coverage = 'partial'::text) OR ((failure_code IS NULL) AND (next_index = total_results) AND (stored_count = total_results)))) OR ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (coverage IS NULL) AND (failure_code IS NOT NULL)))))

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack.guard_nvd_analysis_run()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'vulntrack'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'El historial de análisis es inmutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.kind <> 'nvd_cve' OR NEW.status <> 'queued' OR NEW.page_count <> 0
           OR NEW.retrieved_count <> 0 OR NEW.stored_count <> 0 OR NEW.next_index <> 0
           OR NEW.started_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'La consulta NVD debe iniciar en queued' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,NEW.target_id,NEW.technology_id,
               NEW.kind,NEW.initiated_by,NEW.selected_cpe,NEW.request_key,NEW.request_hash,
               NEW.query_parameters,NEW.created_at)
           IS DISTINCT FROM
           ROW(OLD.id,OLD.workspace_id,OLD.application_id,OLD.target_id,OLD.technology_id,
               OLD.kind,OLD.initiated_by,OLD.selected_cpe,OLD.request_key,OLD.request_hash,
               OLD.query_parameters,OLD.created_at)
           OR OLD.status IN ('completed','failed')
           OR NOT ((OLD.status='queued' AND NEW.status IN ('running','failed'))
                OR (OLD.status='running' AND NEW.status IN ('running','completed','failed')))
           OR NEW.retrieved_count < OLD.retrieved_count
           OR NEW.stored_count < OLD.stored_count
           OR NEW.page_count < OLD.page_count
           OR NEW.next_index < OLD.next_index
           OR (OLD.total_results IS NOT NULL AND NEW.total_results IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_results)
           OR NOT (NEW.warning_codes @> OLD.warning_codes)
           OR NOT (NEW.source_timestamps @> OLD.source_timestamps)
           OR NOT (NEW.page_manifest @> OLD.page_manifest)
           OR (OLD.started_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.started_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.started_at) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transición o snapshot NVD inválido' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack.has_workspace_role(target_workspace uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'vulntrack'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM vulntrack.workspace_members wm
        JOIN vulntrack.users u ON u.id = wm.user_id
        WHERE wm.workspace_id = target_workspace AND wm.user_id = vulntrack.current_user_id()
          AND wm.role = ANY(allowed_roles) AND u.active
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack.is_workspace_creator(target_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'vulntrack'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM vulntrack.workspaces w
        WHERE w.id = target_workspace AND w.created_by = vulntrack.current_user_id()
    )
$function$

functions.name: require_workspace_owner
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack.require_workspace_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'vulntrack'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM vulntrack.workspace_members wm
        WHERE wm.workspace_id = NEW.id AND wm.user_id = NEW.created_by AND wm.role = 'owner'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'el creador debe ser owner del workspace' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END $function$
